title: One cube, a thousand cubes
hook: Cut a 1 cm cube into 1,000 tiny ones. The volume stays. What happens to the outside?

knows: that powders burn or dissolve faster than lumps
doesNotKnow: that cutting keeps the volume but multiplies the outside area
that only the outside of a solid can meet a reactant

misconception: Cutting something into pieces does not change its surface.
objective: The learner can say that cutting a 1 cm cube into 1,000 cubes of 1 mm raises the total outside area from 6 cm² to 60 cm², ten times more, and that this is why finer solids react faster.

claims.text: A cube with edge a has outside area 6a², so a 1 cm cube has 6 cm².
claims.source: Six square faces of area a²; a = 1 cm gives 6 cm² (geometry).

claims.text: Cutting each edge into n equal parts gives n × n × n pieces (2 per edge: 8; 5: 125; 10: 1,000), each with edge 10/n mm.
claims.source: n³ pieces; 1 cm = 10 mm so edge = 10/n mm (node; Demo.tsx).

claims.text: The total outside area of the pieces is 6n cm²: 12 cm² for 8 pieces, 30 cm² for 125, 60 cm² for 1,000.
claims.source: n³ × 6 × (1/n)² = 6n cm² (node; Demo.tsx area1(n)). Equals ten times the original at n = 10.

claims.text: Each 1 mm cube has outside area 6 × (0.1 cm)² = 0.06 cm², and 1,000 of them add up to 60 cm².
Cutting does not change the total volume, 1 cm³.
claims.source: n³ × (1/n)³ cm³ = 1 cm³ (geometry). Ignores material lost in the cuts.

claims.text: A reaction between a solid and something around it can only happen at the solid's outside, so with 10 times the outside area (60 cm² against 6 cm²) a reaction has 10 times as much surface to work on and finer pieces react faster, other things equal.
claims.source: Surface-area effect on rate (Atkins, Physical Chemistry, heterogeneous reactions; Chemistry LibreTexts, Factors affecting reaction rates). Other things equal. | FACT-CHECK 2026-10-14 (pass 13): Heterogeneous reactions occur at the interface; rate scales with exposed area other things equal (LibreTexts, Factors affecting reaction rates). 60/6 = 10. Qualified correctly with "other things equal".

recall.question: A 2 cm cube (outside area 24 cm²) is cut into eight 1 cm cubes. The total outside area becomes…
recall.why: Each 1 cm cube has 6 cm²; eight of them give 48 cm², twice the original, while the volume is unchanged.
